Database Studio

Enterprise SQL Workbench, Database Analyzer & Schema Inspector embedded directly inside the Odoo web client. Multi-tab query editing, foldable statement outlines, selection execution, a result panel per statement, full-result column totals, text-to-number column conversion, and high-capacity Excel reporting.

Animated Module Walkthrough

A continuous walkthrough of Database Studio v17.0.2.7.0, captured from a live Odoo 17 instance:

1. Overview

Database Studio is a technical database management, query analysis, and schema exploration workbench built directly into Odoo 17. It bridges high-level Odoo data models with underlying PostgreSQL relational database schemas, empowering System Administrators, Odoo Developers, and Data Analysts to inspect database structures, analyze table relationships, write SQL, and extract reporting data without leaving their browser.

Zero External Dependencies: Access your Odoo PostgreSQL database safely within your browser session without configuring SSH tunnels, exposed database ports, or external tools (pgAdmin/DBeaver).
Target Audience
  • Database Administrators (DBAs): Schema inspection & query optimization.
  • Odoo Developers: Custom module table validation & SQL testing.
  • Data Analysts: Ad-hoc reporting & 200k-row Excel exports.

2. Core Features & Capabilities

Multi-Tab SQL Workspace

Work on multiple queries simultaneously across persistent editor tabs. Retains query text, results, and column selections when switching tabs.

One Editor, Foldable Statements

The whole script stays in a single editor so any part of it can be selected and run. Statements are outlined with fold controls in the left margin, and dollar-quoted bodies (DO $$ … $$) are recognised as one statement.

Selection-Driven Execution

Highlight any part of the script and click Execute to run only that. The executed section stays highlighted afterwards, so it is always clear what was run.

A Result Panel per Statement

Run a script — or a selection spanning several statements — and each one reports on its own: its own bar, row count, grid, pager and Export. Every panel folds away from its bar, so a long script reads as a list of outcomes.

Schema-Aware Autocomplete

Suggestions drawn from the live schema as you type: tables, views, their columns, aliases already in the query, plus SQL keywords and functions.

Cancel a Running Query

A long query can be stopped from the running bar without leaving the page; the request is cancelled in PostgreSQL itself rather than merely abandoned in the browser.

Full-Result Column Totals

Sum, Count, Average, Min or Max under each selected column, computed across every row the query returned — not just the 100 on screen.

Field-Level Query Builder

Tick individual columns in the Fields tab, across one table or several, with per-field GROUP BY and ORDER BY and automatic aggregates when grouping.

Text → Number Conversion

Turn text columns that hold numbers into numeric, integer, bigint or double precision, after a dry run that reports what would round, blank or fail.

Line Numbers & Soft Wrap

A numbered gutter beside the editor, with wrapping on by default so long statements stay readable without a horizontal scroll.

Syntax Highlighting & Formatting

Real-time token color-coding for keywords, strings, identifiers, and comments. One-click Format button standardizes SQL layout.

3-Tier Relational Mapping

Discovers joins via PostgreSQL Foreign Keys (pg_constraint), custom declared relations, and matching key column names.

Visual Auto-Join Builder

Select sidebar checkboxes for multiple tables and click Build Query to auto-generate formatted LEFT JOIN SQL statements.

200k-Row Excel Exporter

Stream complete unpaginated result sets directly into native .xlsx spreadsheets with memory safety controls.

Selective Column Copying

Click header columns in the result grid to copy specific fields to clipboard, backed by automatic HTTP non-secure fallbacks.

Dual History Modes

Separate logs for Starred/Saved queries vs ad-hoc On-the-fly execution logs with run statistics and instant re-opening.

3. User Manual & Workflow

3.1 Access Rights & Menu Setup

Access is restricted strictly to users assigned to the Database Studio group (database_studio.group_database_studio_user), granted by default to System Administrators.

  • Analyser Workbench: Database Studio ➔ Analyser
  • Query History: Database Studio ➔ History
  • Custom Relations: Database Studio ➔ Relations

3.2 Database Explorer & Sidebar Controls

The sidebar lists all public schema tables and views with flexible search match modes (Anywhere, Starts with, Ends with), Favourites starring (☆), and multi-select checkboxes for batch actions.

3.3 Sample Query & Code Editor

-- Sample Multi-Statement Query in Analyser Tab SELECT p.id, p.name, c.name AS company FROM res_partner p LEFT JOIN res_company c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE p.active = true; SELECT count(*), state FROM sale_order GROUP BY state;

The whole script lives in one editor, so Ctrl+A or any partial selection can be executed as-is, and the + / − icons in the left margin fold a statement away. Both statements above run, and each reports in its own collapsible result panel — see 3.4.

3.4 Running Several Statements at Once

A run reports one panel per statement, in the order they were written, under a strip saying how many ran with Expand all and Collapse all.

  • The bar: each panel shows its statement number, its SQL on one line, and a status — the row count for a result, 1 row(s) affected for an UPDATE, Error, or Not executed. Click it to hide or show that result.
  • Its own everything: every panel keeps its own pager, totals row, column selection, Copy and Export Excel; paging one re-runs that statement alone.
  • The first failure stops the run: PostgreSQL aborts the transaction on error, so what the earlier statements wrote is rolled back with it and the rest are marked Not executed rather than run against a database that has already moved.

A single statement is unchanged: no strip, no bar, just the result grid.

4. Why Choose Database Studio?

1. Eliminates External Database Software

No need to configure psql terminal access, SSH tunnels, or external desktop tools (pgAdmin/DBeaver) for standard queries or schema inspection.

2. Native Security & Context

Operates safely within Odoo authenticated sessions, enforcing RBAC permissions without exposing external database ports or credentials.

3. Accelerated Query Generation

Detects relational links automatically and generates formatted LEFT JOIN queries with a single click.

4. Zero Data Loss Workspace

Switching between Odoo apps or browser menus retains open query tabs, editor selections, and result grid states.

5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Access is strictly limited to users assigned to the Database Studio group (database_studio.group_database_studio_user). By default, System Administrators (base.group_system) inherit this group automatically.

Yes. Database Studio features a multi-tab query workspace. Click the + button to create new query tabs. Each tab independently preserves its query text, folds, execution results and column selections.

Highlight any lines or snippet in the editor and click Execute; only the highlighted selection runs, and it stays marked afterwards so it is clear what was executed. A selection spanning several statements runs all of them, each reported in its own result panel.

Yes. Authorized administrators can execute any valid PostgreSQL statement supported by your database user connection. For non-SELECT statements, the panel reports the affected row count (e.g., 15 row(s) affected) on its bar.

Every statement is executed and reported separately: one collapsible result panel each, in the order written, so nothing in a script runs unseen. The first failure ends the run — PostgreSQL aborts the transaction and rolls back whatever the earlier statements wrote — and the statements after it are marked Not executed.

Yes. Excel exports (Export Excel) pull the complete, unpaginated result set directly from PostgreSQL, capped at 200,000 rows to protect server memory.

6. Release History

Version 17.0.2.7.0 Current Release
  • A Result Panel per Statement: running a script showed only the last statement's rows, because a cursor keeps only the final result set. Each statement is now executed and reported separately, in its own collapsible panel.
  • Per-Panel Actions: pager, totals, column selection, Copy and Export Excel belong to one panel each; paging a panel re-runs only its statement.
  • Stop on First Failure: an error ends the run, since PostgreSQL aborts the transaction and rolls back what the earlier statements wrote. The statements that never ran are marked Not executed.
Version 17.0.2.3.0
  • Text → Number Conversion: convert text columns holding numbers to numeric, integer, bigint or double precision, with a dry run reporting blanks, roundings and unconvertible values before anything is written.
  • Fields Tab for Query Results: with no table ticked, the Fields tab describes the columns the current query returned, typed from the cursor.
Version 17.0.2.1.0
  • One Editor, Foldable Statements: the per-statement editors are gone; the whole script sits in a single editor with a fold outline in the left margin, and a DO $$ … $$ body is no longer torn apart at its inner semicolons.
  • Rewritten SQL Formatter: one clause per line with real indentation for sub-queries, CTEs and CASE bodies.
  • Full-Result Column Totals: Sum / Count / Average / Min / Max over every row returned rather than the visible page.
  • Field-Level Query Builder: build a SELECT from individual columns, with per-field GROUP BY and ORDER BY.
Version 17.0.2.0.0
  • Multi-Tab Workspace: Concurrent query sessions across persistent tabs.
  • Statement Splitting: Multi-statement SQL parsing into collapsible statement blocks (superseded in 17.0.2.1.0).
  • Selection Execution: Highlight code to run selection-only execution.
  • High-Performance FK Resolver: Fast pg_constraint catalog relational resolution.
  • Selective Column Copy: Header column selection with HTTP fallback.
  • High-Capacity Excel Exporter: 200,000-row streaming Excel exporter (xlsxwriter).
Version 17.0.1.0.0

Initial release of Database Studio for Odoo 17 containing single-tab query editor, database object browser, field inspector, and custom relations mapping.
